note: Derived from undercity-spec.md §8 (Round Configuration), converted to CONTINUOUS GAMEFLOW (2026-09-21) and then to the SIMPLIFIED ROUND DISPLAY (2026-09-21): the visible flow is Round 0 → Round 4 and nothing else. One phase per round, so what the engine tracks and what a screen shows are the same thing and no internal pacing name can leak onto a projector. The descriptive names those rounds used to carry — Stable Ops, Interdependence, Core Failure, Aftershock — live in the facilitator's runbook, on paper, and nowhere in this file. A round still carries its own inject timeline and fault pool (timelines[] in the scenario), and still resets NOTHING when it changes: production, upkeep and every allowance ride the OPERATING CYCLE (defaults.cycle_length_s), and MASTER TIME is one countdown for the whole live shift (defaults.live_length_s). Balance numbers live in config/scenarios/*.json, which override these defaults.

rounds.name: Stable Ops
rounds.purpose: Baseline capture — must feel comfortably manageable

rounds.name: Interdependence
rounds.injects: Cross-sector cascades x4-5; 1 false alarm; discrepancy live

rounds.name: Core Failure
rounds.injects: Critical stack x3; Core drops to 60% at 05:00; Continuity Order due 25:00
rounds.purpose: Peak stress; values conflict; decision under deadline

rounds.name: Aftershock
rounds.purpose: Post-measurement — the delta is the product
